educationalGoal: In this capstone project, students will conduct research activities related to IT systems based on the knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology that they have learned so far. Through these activities, students acquire the abilities needed for identifying a problem, designing the project, and implementing an IT system. advice:
In this project, students learn R&D methods in IoT field.

Specific research areas focused in this project are as follows:

1. FPGA architecture and CAD.
2. Wearable devices development and analisys for sports and health care.
3. Educational materials on embedded systems and STEAM.
4. Tourism informatics
5. e-sports support
6. Development of embedded systems in cooperation with local communities.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set a project schedule based on a set research topic goal.
Be able to set an appropriate approach or method for the project.
Be able to acquire the IT knowledge and skills needed for proceeding with the project.

              In this capstone project, students will conduct research activities related to IT systems based on the knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology that they have learned so far. Through these activities, students acquire the abilities needed for identifying a problem, designing the project, and implementing an IT system. Additionally, students will acquire generic abilities related to communicating with others, and evaluating results.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this project, students learn R&D methods in IoT field.

Specific research areas focused in this project are as follows:

1. FPGA architecture and CAD.
2. Wearable devices development and analisys for sports and health care.
3. Educational materials on embedded systems and STEAM.
4. Tourism informatics
5. e-sports support
6. Development of embedded systems in cooperation with local communities.
